Name: Nature In The Valley - Anthro Patch
Author: Nanopede
Description:
I absolutely love the bug catching element of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nature In The Valley[/url], but unfortunately I'm a furry who can't play without [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url]. So, I made an alternative portrait and edited her overworld sprite to make her fit in more. :]

You will probably want this to go with it: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37869]Central Station - Anthro Patch[/url]

Thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/w8AwA8w]w8AwA8w[/url] for the permission to make and post this!

I don't believe any other edits should be necessary from my testing, but let me know if I need to fix anything. This is my first mod and I'm still trying to figure out what i'm doing, hahaha. That being said, if I disappear off the face of the earth and it needs to be changed feel free to fix it and post that fix. Similarly, feel free to edit the portrait however you want, as long as you are respectful to the original vision of Ivy's creator. As the overworld sprites are not my original assets, please ask the original Nature In The Valley creator about that.
